project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Local Cadw and National Monuments Record of Wales data and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 3 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 0 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Caehopkin
townGuide.intro: Caehopkin has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records defensible heritage and practical stops without presenting the place as a destination.

suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Use the map to understand the settlement and its currently curated public facilities.
